components.text:
Circle: medium circle, ritual chalk.

Links two living creatures in the circle for a while (60 seconds unless the server changes it): a share of the damage either takes, the other takes too (half unless the server changes it).
Only a witch type can work it. No NPC Original or boss can be linked. Another player must agree by sneaking in the circle with a lead in their main hand, and only where PvP is on.
A refusal always reads the same and still spends the lead, the amethyst and the altar's power. The grimoire always comes back.
